title: IBM's quantum computer did in 19 seconds what a supercomputer could take 110 years to do!
key_facts: IBM Nighthawk R2 processor ran random circuit sampling
Frontier supercomputer estimated at about 110 years
Estimate uses tensor-network contraction and depends on method
Preprint on arXiv, not peer reviewed
Advantage is on a specialised benchmark only
quote_evidence: However, the estimate depends on the simulation method.
The research, available as a preprint on arXiv, has also not undergone peer review.
why_it_matters_hint: Quantum advantage claim on a narrow benchmark.
notes: Source text is Moneycontrol's write-up of the preprint; the preprint itself was not opened.
